senses.gloss: (variously corrupted) f. (πρόσταγμα) ordinance, proclamation. Tanḥ. Ekeb 11 פרוזדוגייא (corr. acc.), v. דַּוָּאר I. Pesik. Shor, p. 77ᵃ; Tanḥ. Emor 10 למלך ששלח פ׳ שלו וכ׳ like a king that sent his proclamation to a province &c.; הדא קרית שמע פ׳ שלי וכ׳ this reading of the Sh’mʿa (Deut. VI, 4) is my (God’s) proclamation &c.; Lev. R. s. 27.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42:3">Gen. R. s. 42</cite> <he>פרסטגמא</he>. Pesik. Baḥod., p. 102ᵃ <he>שלא יהו דברי תורה בעיניך כפ׳ וכ׳</he> that the words of the Law be not in thy eyes like an old proclamation, but like a new one, which all run to read; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 960:11">Yalk. Prov. 960</cite>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 33">Pesik. R. s. 33</cite> [read:] <he>פ׳ שלו פרושה בחדש הראשון בשלשה עשר יום בו</he> his (Haman’s) decree was promulgated in the first month &c. (<cite ref="Esther 3:12">Esth. III, 12</cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 336">Yalk. Is. 336</cite> (corr. acc.); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="Q01713"><he>פְּרוֹסְטַגְמָאוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01713"><he>פְּרוֹזְדַּגְמָ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17">Lev. R. s. 17</cite> <he>שלש פ׳ שלח וכ׳</he> Joshua sent three proclamations to the Canaanites: whoever wishes to emigrate &c.; Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᶜ bot. <he>פרסטיגיות</he> (corr. acc.). V. <cite ref="D00450"><he>דִּיאֲטַגְמָא</he></cite>.
